MOLLY C. DWYER, CLERK U.S. COURT OF APPEALS | TODD YUKUTAKE; DAVID KIKUKAWA, Plaintiffs-Appellees, v. ANNE E. LOPEZ, In her Official Capacity as the Attorney General of the State of Hawaii, Defendant-Appellant, and CITY AND COUNTY OF HONOLULU, Defendant. | No. 21-16756 D.C. No. 1:19-cv-00578-JMS-RT District of Hawaii, Honolulu ORDER |
| --- | --- | MURGUIA , Chief Judge: Upon the vote of a majority of nonrecused active judges, it is ordered that this case be reheard en banc pursuant to Federal Rule of Appellate Procedure 40(c) and Circuit Rule 40-3. The three-judge panel opinion is vacated. Judge Bennett did not participate in the deliberations or vote in this case.
